self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: 4pc: The equipping character's Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon reaction DMG are increased by 40%, and their Lunar-Bloom reaction DMG is increased by 10%. Additionally, after the equipping character triggers Bloom, Hyperbloom, Lunar-Bloom, or Burgeon, they will gain another 25% bonus to the effects mentioned prior. Each stack of this lasts 10s. Max 4 stacks simultaneously. This effect can only be triggered once per second. The character who equips this can still trigger its effects when not on the field. Modeled as GO does: the 40% Bloom/Hyperbloom/Burgeon and 10% Lunar-Bloom base, plus 25% of that per Sprout stack (+10% / +2.5%), 0-4 stacks; the default is the full 4 stacks (80% / 20%), which a Bloom team holds near-permanently. States are a list, not an object: JSONB re-sorts object keys, which would make 0 stacks the default.

bonuses.4: The equipping character's Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon reaction DMG are increased by 40%, and their Lunar-Bloom reaction DMG is increased by 10%. Additionally, after the equipping character triggers Bloom, Hyperbloom, Lunar-Bloom, or Burgeon, they will gain another 25% bonus to the effects mentioned prior. Each stack of this lasts 10s. Max 4 stacks simultaneously. This effect can only be triggered once per second. The character who equips this can still trigger its effects when not on the field.

bonuses.2: Augmente la maîtrise élémentaire de 80 pts.
bonuses.4: Augmente les DGT infligés par les réactions de Fleurissement, d'Exubérance et de Bourgeonnement du personnage équipé de l'artéfact de 40 % et les DGT de ses réactions de Sélénofleurissement de 10 %. De plus, lorsque le personnage équipé de l'artéfact a déclenché une réaction de Fleurissement, de Sélénofleurissement, d'Exubérance ou de Bourgeonnement, le bonus mentionné précédemment augmente de 25 % pendant 10 s. Cet effet peut être cumulé 4 fois maximum et déclenché une fois toutes les secondes. Cet effet peut être déclenché même si le personnage équipé de l'artéfact fait partie de l'équipe mais n'est pas déployé.

Aumenta em 40% o Dano infligido pelas reações de Florescimento, Superflorescimento e Germinação de seu portador; aumenta o Dano de Florescimento Lunar em 10%. Além disto, após o personagem que está com isso equipado desencadear as reações de Florescimento, Superflorescimento, Germinação e Florescimento Lunar o bônus descrito acima é aumentado em 25%. Este efeito dura 10s e pode ser acumulado até 4 vezes, podendo ser desencadeado 1 vez por segundo. Este efeito pode ser desencadeado também quando o seu portador está na equipe, porém fora do campo de batalha.
